role: The world listener interface: WorldManager on the server (entity tracker add/remove, block-change and sound packets) and RenderGlobal on the client (re-mesh marks, sounds, particles, break progress).

members.name: markBlockForUpdate
members.note: world.c notes the server's block-change packet mark is folded into the set path, not a listener

members.name: markBlockForRenderUpdate
members.note: client re-mesh mark; the native renderer rebuilds from the world state

members.name: markBlockRangeForRenderUpdate
members.note: no state; comments in activate.c and servertick.c say so

members.name: spawnParticle
members.note: client particles live in particles_live.c; not every particle name is ported

members.name: playAuxSFX
members.note: many call sites note 'no state'; the 2001 break particles go through particles_live.c

members.name: destroyBlockPartially
members.note: survival.h carries RenderGlobal's local destroy progress; not a listener

notes: No listener abstraction in C; each effect is inlined where it matters. I did not check that tracker_add is called from every entity spawn path. Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): interface, marker or abstract base; its behavior lives in the subclasses' ports.
